ParameterDescription.Name: Manufacturing Command
ParameterDescription.Description: 0x3FFF to write manufacturing data to storage. 0x1000 means success. 0x2000 means failure. 0x0100 means some are all data was blank. 0x0010 means some or all data has already been written.

ParameterDescription.Name: Test Mode Command
ParameterDescription.Description: 0x1FFF to test digital outputs. 0x2FFF to test PWM outputs. 0x3FFF to turn CAN off and switch 48V and 12V on.

ParameterDescription.Name: Run Bootload Command
ParameterDescription.Description: 0x3FFF to jump to bootloader. 0x5FFF to reset the system.

ParameterDescription.Name: Save to Flash Command
ParameterDescription.Description: 0x3FFF to save to flash. 0x1000 means success. 0x2000 means failure.
